evidence.reason: The current dependency regex enumerates [Unit] dependency directives but omits systemd's StopPropagatedFrom= and PropagatesStopTo=. Since the scan already treats stop-affecting directives such as PartOf= as dependencies, ignoring these two lets a co-installed unit either be stopped when crq-tick.service is stopped or stop crq-tick.service without discovery noticing. This is an implementation gap in the existing dependency scan, not a new requirement.
